products.name: EMA Ribbon (4-Layer)
products.description: Draws 4 EMAs in a gradient. When stacked in order, you're trending. The foundation of trend reading.
products.preview:
ema1 = ta.ema(close, 8)
ema2 = ta.ema(close, 26)
ema3 = ta.ema(close, 80)
ema4 = ta.ema(close, 233)

products.name: Previous Day High/Low/Close
products.description: Horizontal lines at yesterday's High, Low, and Close. Simple but powerful institutional levels.
products.preview:
[pd_h, pd_l, pd_c] = request.security("D",
    [high[1], low[1], close[1]])

products.name: Weekly Open Line
products.description: Horizontal line at weekly open. Above = bullish week bias, below = bearish. Institutional key level.
products.preview: weekly_open = request.security("W", open)

products.name: Candle Countdown Timer
products.description: Countdown to current candle close. Never get caught off guard by a candle closing.
products.preview:
remaining = tf_ms - elapsed
mins = remaining / 60000
secs = remaining / 1000 % 60

products.name: Session Highlighter
products.description: Colors chart background during London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney sessions. Know which session you're trading.
products.preview:
is_london = t >= 480 and t < 990
is_ny = t >= 810 and t < 1200
bgcolor(is_london ? london_col : na)

products.name: MA Crossover Signals
products.description: Two MAs with golden cross and death cross arrows. Classic trend-following entry signals.
products.preview:
cross_up = ta.crossover(fast, slow)
cross_down = ta.crossunder(fast, slow)

products.name: Trend Strength Meter (ADX)
products.description: Visual meter showing trend strength. Green = strong trend, red = no trend. Avoid choppy markets.
products.preview:
[di_plus, di_minus, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
trending = adx > 25

products.name: Volume Spike Detector
products.description: Highlights bars where volume is above average. High volume confirms moves — without it, breakouts fail.
products.preview:
vol_avg = ta.sma(volume, 20)
is_spike = volume > vol_avg * 2.0

products.name: Pivot Point Levels
products.description: Classic floor trader pivots from yesterday's price. Central pivot + 3 support + 3 resistance levels.
products.preview:
pp = (pd_h + pd_l + pd_c) / 3
r1 = 2 * pp - pd_l
s1 = 2 * pp - pd_h

products.name: Daily Range Percentage
products.description: Shows what % of average daily range today's candle has consumed. 120% = overextended, 30% = room to run.
products.preview:
range_pct = (today_range / adr) * 100
// 100% = normal, >120% = extended

products.name: Spread Monitor
products.description: Live bid-ask spread in pips. Know when your broker widens spreads before you trade.
products.preview:
spread_raw = syminfo.ask - syminfo.bid
spread_pips = spread_raw / pip_size

products.name: EMA Trend Classifier
products.description: Returns BULL/BEAR/NEUTRAL based on EMA stack alignment. Simple true/false values for any strategy.
products.preview:
is_trend_bull = ema4 < ema3 and ema3 < ema2
is_trend_bear = ema4 > ema3 and ema3 > ema2
ema_bias = is_trend_bull ? "BULL" : "BEAR"

products.name: ATR Stop Loss Calculator
products.description: Dynamic stop loss based on ATR. Shows exact price and pip distance. No more guessing where to put your stop.
products.preview:
atr_val = ta.atr(14)
sl_dist = atr_val * multiplier
sl_price = close - sl_dist

products.name: Position Size Calculator
products.description: Shows lot size based on account, risk %, and stop distance. Never risk more than intended.
products.preview:
risk_amt = account * (risk_pct / 100)
lot_size = risk_amt / (sl_pips * pip_value)

products.name: Alert Template (Webhook-Ready)
products.description: Copy-paste template for webhook-ready JSON alerts. Define your condition, get formatted payloads.
products.preview:
alert('{"action":"OPEN","direction":"LONG",
"symbol":"' + syminfo.ticker + '"}')

products.name: Risk/Reward Box Drawer
products.description: Click entry, stop, and target — draws green/red boxes showing your R:R ratio. Visual risk management.
products.preview:
risk = math.abs(entry - sl)
reward = math.abs(tp - entry)
rr = reward / risk
// Draws TP/SL boxes

products.name: VWAP with Deviation Bands
products.description: VWAP with configurable σ bands. Institutions use VWAP as fair price — deviations show extremes.
products.preview:
vwap = ta.vwap(close)
upper_1 = vwap + 1 * stdev
lower_1 = vwap - 1 * stdev

products.name: Candle Pattern Detector
products.description: Detects Engulfing, Doji, Hammer, Shooting Star, Morning/Evening Star. Visual markers on your chart.
products.preview:
bull_engulf = is_bear[1] and is_bull
             and body > body[1]
hammer = lower_wick > body * 2

products.name: Bollinger Squeeze Detector
products.description: Detects when BB squeezes inside KC — volatility compression. When it fires, a big move is coming.
products.preview:
squeeze_on = bb_lower > kc_lower
            and bb_upper < kc_upper
mom = ta.linreg(close - basis, 20, 0)

products.name: Multi-Timeframe Dashboard
products.description: EMA trend direction across 4 timeframes at once. See the full picture in one glance.

products.name: HTF Candle Overlay
products.description: Draws higher-timeframe candle as a box on your chart. See the 4H candle while trading 15M.
products.preview:
[o,h,l,c] = request.security("240", [open,high,low,close])
// Draws candle box on right side

products.name: RSI with Divergence Detection
products.description: Standard RSI with automatic bullish/bearish divergence detection. Labels appear when price and RSI disagree.
products.preview:
bull_div = rsi_higher_low and price_lower_low
bear_div = rsi_lower_high and price_higher_high

products.name: Opening Range Breakout
products.description: Draws first 30/60 min high/low as a box. Breakouts from opening range often trend all session.
products.preview:
if bars_elapsed * tf_mins < or_minutes
    or_high = math.max(or_high, high)
    or_low = math.min(or_low, low)

products.name: Fibonacci Auto-Draw
products.description: Automatically draws Fib retracements between recent swing high/low. Updates dynamically.
products.preview:
levels = [0, 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1.0]
// Auto-detects swings, draws levels

products.name: Volatility Band System
products.description: 8-level ATR classifier. Colors candles by volatility intensity. Bands 6/7/8 = trigger zones for fades. Core Recoil concept.
products.preview:
ratio = trueRange / ta.atr(8)
volBand = ratio > 3.0 ? 8 :
         ratio > 2.55 ? 7 :
         ratio > 2.10 ? 6 : 5

products.name: Fair Value Gap Detector
products.description: Finds gaps where buyers/sellers didn't overlap. Tracks lifecycle: fresh → tapped → filled. ICT/SMC essential.

products.name: Liquidity Pool Detector
products.description: Finds swing highs/lows and draws horizontal levels. Where stop losses cluster — the levels institutions target.

products.name: Regime Scanner
products.description: Scores trading conditions 0-90. Grades: PRIME, FAVORABLE, MARGINAL, DEGRADED. The decision-making engine behind Cockpit.
products.preview:
vs = volatility_normal ? 40 : 20
ts = math.min(adx, 50)
score = vs + ts
label = score > 70 ? "PRIME" : ...
